title: StreamingText fires onDone once when motion is reduced
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists

evidence.verified: Reverting the fix fails exactly the new test: `npx vitest run src/components/StreamingText.test.tsx` exits 1 with `expected "vi.fn()" to be called 2 times, but got 1 times`, and exits 0 with the fix, 11 tests passing. `npm run check` exits 0.

details:
`components/StreamingText.md:75` says `onDone` fires exactly once per `text` value, after the last character is revealed.

`src/components/StreamingText.tsx:55` returns from the effect early when `done` is set or `prefersReducedMotion()` is true. The reset of `firedDoneRef` sits below that return, at `:61`. The ref therefore stays true after the first message, and no later `text` value fires the callback again.

A consumer chaining messages off `onDone` stalls after the first one, for every user who has asked for reduced motion.

`:83` also guards on `text.length > 0`, so an empty `text` never fires it at all.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.

The reset of the ref moved above the early return, so a new `text` starts un-fired whether or not it animates. The empty-text half of the report was closed in the specification rather than the code: an empty `text` reveals no characters, so there is no last character to fire after, and the document now says so.
